design.interface: ICampaignAppendControls gains optional onNotCommitted?: () => void (trusted, server-only, default-absent; never in batch, payload, command identity or wire).
design.adapter: appendControlledCampaignBatch: hook joins capability detection (hook-only controls on a non-SQLite journal refuse append-controls-unsupported before any write). A recorded command short-circuits before guard and hook. After the guard admits, append() and the saved-record afterCommit extension run in a try: a non-committed result or a throw calls the hook in the same synchronous extension span, then returns/rethrows the original outcome. A throwing hook never replaces that outcome.
design.host: CampaignMatchHost.commitEvents includes the hook in its capability check and forwards the identical function.
design.binder: commitGuardedProgression binds onNotCommitted: release; onCommitted (consume then release), afterRelease and the reservation microtask fallback are unchanged.
design.boundary: No activation, no port installation, no cross-file atomicity claim. Native outer-COMMIT failure after the extension returns stays unrepaired and recorded (rBoundary #2249); any writer-level widening is a separate registration.
